design_points_implemented: NormalizedCost: exactly five nonnegative components in fixed order length/time/cumulative_risk/curvature/uncertainty; int, finite float and Fraction accepted; bool/negative/NaN/Inf/unsupported rejected; floats stored as exact binary rationals; weights fixed (1, 1/2, 4, 1/2, 1); no caller weight override; exact rational weighted total

Edge/CandidateGraph: immutable ids and costs, nonempty-string ids, tuple copies so caller-list mutation cannot alter the graph; max 64 nodes / 512 edges; duplicate node ids, duplicate edge ids and unknown endpoints rejected up front even if unreachable; parallel distinct edges, self loops and cycles allowed; source_domain must be exactly software_fixture

search(start, goal, max_expansions): deterministic bounded Dijkstra over labels (exact cost, hop count, lexicographic edge-id sequence) independent of insertion order; zero-cost cycles cannot improve a label; expansion_count <= node count; budget is an exact non-bool integer in 0..64

Result semantics: start==goal -> found with empty edge path and cost 0 without expansion; a pending candidate blocked by budget -> budget_exhausted (never a partial path reported as found); exhausted heap without path -> unreachable; cost reported only when found; no motion/execution authorization field anywhere

Tests: independent hand-coded weight formula plus all-simple-paths enumeration over 100 fixed-seed graphs (2..7 nodes, integer/rational/zero costs, parallel variants, cycles, unreachable pairs); every ordered pair compared; permutations, tie cases, caller-list mutation, malformed inputs, budget truncation and a minimal-checkout portability run included

limits: Scope limit: this evidence covers only the final book's first small-graph exhaustive cost check (fixed J weights, exact rational arithmetic, deterministic bounded abstract-graph search). It is NOT full G04 and not a planner, geometry, sensor, map or AI acceptance.

Missing inputs, explicitly NOT frozen or invented here: production normalization scales for length/time/curvature/uncertainty, risk calibration of cumulative_risk, legal observation adapters (scene/EM/sensor), orientation-aware motion primitives, full-volume collision checking and braking-tail evidence, and runtime/latency inputs. The five components must already be normalized by an explicit policy; this job supplies a software_fixture policy only.

All inputs are labelled software_fixture. No scene file, truth query, oracle, ML model, real or simulated stream was read; the module imports only dataclasses/fractions/heapq/math and performs no I/O, clock, thread or network access.

The API cannot authorize motion and cannot declare that a drill reached a gate; returned paths exist only inside the abstract input graph. No geometry, collision-safe or execution field exists anywhere in the module.

3D coordinates appear only as synthetic fixture metadata used to generate distance-like costs inside the unit tests; they are not real geometry and certify nothing about curvature, orientation or swept volumes.

No timing measurement was performed in this job. If a future job measures time, it must be labelled a pure-graph software microbenchmark with fixture counts and must not be reported as end-to-end perception+planning latency or as a G04 pass.
